files.test_impl.py:
import os
import pytest
from impl import run


def _mk(tmp_path, content):
    d = tmp_path / 'inbox' / 'f'
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / 'customer_feedback.csv').write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
    os.chdir(tmp_path)
    return 'f'


CSV = 'date,customer,channel,text\n2026-07-01,A s.r.o.,email,"Hi, there"\n2026-08-01,B a.s.,phone,Late\nbad,C,email,x\n'


def test_basic(tmp_path):
    r = run({'folder': _mk(tmp_path, CSV)})
    assert len(r['records']) == 2
    assert r['records'][0]['text'] == 'Hi, there'
    assert len(r['errors']) == 1


def test_filters(tmp_path):
    f = _mk(tmp_path, CSV)
    assert len(run({'folder': f, 'from_date': '2026-07-15'})['records']) == 1
    assert run({'folder': f, 'channel_filter': 'email'})['records'][0]['customer'] == 'A s.r.o.'
    assert run({'folder': f, 'customer_filter': 'b a'})['records'][0]['channel'] == 'phone'


def test_bad_input(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'nope_xyz'})
    f = _mk(tmp_path, CSV)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': f, 'from_date': 'garbage'})

import pytest
from impl import run


def _mk(tmp_path, monkeypatch, content):
    d = tmp_path / 'inbox' / 'f'
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / 'customer_feedback.csv').write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)


CSV = 'date,customer,channel,text\n2026-07-01,A,email,"x, y"\n2026-08-01,B,phone,hi\n2026-09-01,A,phone,yo\n'


def test_basic(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _mk(tmp_path, monkeypatch, CSV)
    r = run({'folder': 'f'})['records']
    assert [x['id'] for x in r] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert r[0]['text'] == 'x, y'


def test_filters_keep_ids(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _mk(tmp_path, monkeypatch, CSV)
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'customer_filter': 'a', 'from_date': '2026-08-15'})['records']
    assert [x['id'] for x in r] == [3]
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'channel_filter': 'PHONE'})['records']
    assert [x['id'] for x in r] == [2, 3]


def test_bad_input(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _mk(tmp_path, monkeypatch, CSV)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'nope'})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'f', 'from_date': 'garbage'})
